about: Sahih Muslim reference numbers (HAD-004). canonicalID keeps the fawazahmed0 sequence number it was created with (bookmarks and topics point at it); displayNumber is the standard Fuad 'Abd al-Baqi / sunnah.com reference. how: arabicnumber+sunnah = sunnah.com block with this label is this narration (letter kept); arabicnumber-base = fawazahmed0 arabicnumber, printed number without letter; introduction = sunnah.com Introduction numbering (1-7, Introduction 8-92); text = same Arabic as a sunnah.com block; inferred-from-neighbours = no number in either source, the Fuad hadith it sits in (N) or the two numbers it lies between (N-M); preface = the Muslim preface. shared = the printed number is also shown on another record (chains of one hadith).
